Families in Gaza are being forced to face another winter without shelter after years of displacement, destruction and no possibility to rebuild their lives.  Now, heavy rains are flooding tents, destroying what little they have left and leaving children exposed to freezing temperatures. And there's nowhere to hide.  A ceasefire has not brought an end to their suffering. Families are still living without the basic protection, food and essentials they need to survive.  Our teams are providing blankets and essential supplies, supporting mothers to protect their babies from the cold, screening for and treating malnutrition and building sand barriers around tents to help reduce flooding.  No family should have to spend another winter like this.  Donate to our Winter Appeal to help us provide vital support to families in Gaza.
